fmiModelDescription.description: FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation wrapper around the third-party PID controller from https://github.com/pms67/PID (c) 2020 Philip Salmony, MIT License. The control algorithm in PID.c/PID.h is unmodified; see sources/.

Category.name: logStatusError
Category.description: Configuration and sample-time consistency problems reported by the controller wrapper

ScalarVariable.name: setpoint
ScalarVariable.description: Desired value of the controlled quantity. The derivative term acts on measurement, not on setpoint, so a setpoint step alone produces no derivative kick.

ScalarVariable.name: measurement
ScalarVariable.description: Measured value of the controlled quantity, as the controller would receive it from a sensor or a plant model.

ScalarVariable.name: Ki
ScalarVariable.description: Integral gain. The integrator uses trapezoidal integration and is clamped to [limMinInt, limMaxInt] (anti-windup).

ScalarVariable.name: Kd
ScalarVariable.description: Derivative gain. The derivative is a band-limited differentiator on measurement (time constant tau), with the sign chosen so a setpoint change alone does not excite it.

ScalarVariable.name: tau
ScalarVariable.description: Time constant of the derivative low-pass filter.

ScalarVariable.name: limMin
ScalarVariable.description: Lower clamp on the controller output. Must not exceed limMax (checked at initialization).

ScalarVariable.name: limMax
ScalarVariable.description: Upper clamp on the controller output. Must not be less than limMin (checked at initialization).

ScalarVariable.name: limMinInt
ScalarVariable.description: Lower clamp on the integrator term (anti-windup). Must not exceed limMaxInt (checked at initialization).

ScalarVariable.name: limMaxInt
ScalarVariable.description: Upper clamp on the integrator term (anti-windup). Must not be less than limMinInt (checked at initialization).

ScalarVariable.name: T
ScalarVariable.description: Controller sample time, used directly in the integral and derivative formulas. Must match the scenario's step_size: a mismatch is reported through the FMU's own logger (logStatusError) at every doStep.

ScalarVariable.name: output
ScalarVariable.description: Controller output: proportional + integral + derivative terms, clamped to [limMin, limMax].

ScalarVariable.name: integrator_state
ScalarVariable.description: Internal integrator accumulator (pid.integrator), after anti-windup clamping to [limMinInt, limMaxInt]. Exposed so a test can check the clamp directly instead of inferring it from the output.

ScalarVariable.name: differentiator_state
ScalarVariable.description: Internal band-limited derivative term (pid.differentiator). Depends on measurement only, not on setpoint.

ScalarVariable.name: error
ScalarVariable.description: setpoint - measurement, as computed by the wrapper for convenience; the controller itself only receives setpoint and measurement.
